title: ap2-evidence evidence bundle (ap2-evidence/1)
description: Container for the artifacts of one AP2 v0.2 purchase. AP2 itself defines no such container; see docs/bundle-format.md.

checkout_mandate.description: Checkout mandate chain: '<open SD-JWT>~<disc>~...~~<closed KB-SD-JWT>~<disc>~...~', or one directly signed SD-JWT ending in '~'.

payment_mandate.description: Payment mandate chain, same shape as checkout_mandate.

checkout_receipt.description: Merchant-signed compact JWT (not an SD-JWT). Also read: a JSON object, or a string holding a JSON object, which is the unsigned receipt some sample flows return. This schema describes what the verifier reads, not what a receipt is worth: an unsigned receipt proves nothing and is reported as unsigned_receipt (INCOMPLETE).

payment_receipt.description: Payment-processor-signed compact JWT (not an SD-JWT). Also read: a JSON object, or a string holding a JSON object, which is the unsigned receipt some sample flows return. This schema describes what the verifier reads, not what a receipt is worth: an unsigned receipt proves nothing and is reported as unsigned_receipt (INCOMPLETE).

keys.description: Public keys supplied with the bundle. They are self-asserted by whoever assembled the bundle; keys passed with --trusted-keys take precedence.

expected.description: Values the closed mandates' aud and nonce must equal.

note.description: Free text, ignored by the verifier.

anyOf.description: Unsigned receipt as a JSON object.
Unsigned receipt as a string holding a JSON object.

jwk.description: EC P-256 public key, mirroring upstream code/sdk/schemas/ap2/types/jwk.json.
